+def _split_special(text, tokens):
+    """
+    Same result as re.split("(" + "|".join(map(re.escape, tokens)) + ")", text)
+    without compiling a pattern: the leftmost occurrence of any token wins, ties
+    at the same position go to the earliest token in order (regex alternation),
+    and the search resumes right after the match.
+    """
+    if "" in tokens:
+        pattern = "(" + "|".join(re.escape(k) for k in tokens) + ")"
+        return re.split(pattern, text)
+    find = text.find
+    # next occurrence (at or after the current position) of every token
+    nxt = [find(t) for t in tokens]
+    parts = []
+    pos = 0
+    while True:
+        best = -1
+        bt = None
+        for i, t in enumerate(tokens):
+            j = nxt[i]
+            if j != -1 and j < pos:
+                j = nxt[i] = find(t, pos)
+            if j != -1 and (best == -1 or j < best):
+                best = j
+                bt = t
+        if bt is None:
+            break
+        parts.append(text[pos:best])
+        parts.append(bt)
+        pos = best + len(bt)
+    parts.append(text[pos:])
+    return parts
+
+
+class RegexTokenizer(Tokenizer):
+
